If root-bound, repot in spring into a pot 3-5 cm wider with a drainage hole and chunky well-draining mix, water in, and keep out of harsh sun for a week
Gently tease apart the clumps and give each its own pot (or keep together in the larger pot)
Check the top 5 cm of soil with a finger and water only when dry
